title: ProperKummerDegreeOneBaseChange
statement: Let $k\subseteq K$ be algebraically closed fields [def-sc-field-extension], and let $f:C\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ be a smooth separated connected proper curve [def-sc-curves]. Let $n\geq1$ be nonzero in $k$. Let $\varphi:\pi^{-1}(\mathrm{Kummer}_C)\to\mathrm{Kummer}_{C_K}$ be a morphism of Kummer short complexes [def-sc-kummer-sequence], where $\pi:C_K\to C$ is the projection, and assume its middle component is the comparison on $\mathbf G_m$ induced by pullback of units. Then the map $H^1(\varphi_1)\circ\rho^1(C,\mu_n):H^1(C,\mu_n)\to H^1(C_K,\mu_n)$ is bijective.

proof.text: Obtain the natural Kummer ladder. Cancel its monic roots-of-unity inclusion to identify its first component with that of the given morphism.

Global units on a proper curve over an algebraically closed field are nth powers: use Scheme.finite_globalSectionsRingHom_of_isProper and IsAlgClosed.exists_pow_eq_of_finite, exactly the two-line proper-unit calculation in the source Curve.Kummer module. This does not invoke GlobalSectionsBijective.of_isAlgClosed or require the stronger global-functions identification. BaseChange_curve retains properness. Kummer exactness then makes beta from H1(mu_n) injective, with image Picard n-torsion.
Use the proper Picard-torsion bijection and conjugate it with the canonical Picard/H1(Gm) equivalences. The Kummer ladder identifies the resulting comparison with beta after the middle pullback.

Injectivity follows from injectivity of beta and the torsion pullback. To lift a target class, lift its beta-image under the torsion bijection and then under source beta. Injectivity of target beta proves the desired equality.
